mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions and rising corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS is above its 1-year moving average over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of months where UNRATE < 8.0% over a 10-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a strong housing market and rising consumer confidence, jointly driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or the interaction term in a regression has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 10-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline (over 1 month) does not lead to negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% over a 10-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals strong economic expansion with rising capacity utilization and labor market tightness, jointly driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window, or the interaction term in a regression has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In the early stages of a housing recovery (HOUST rising above its 12-month low), consumer confidence and spending increase, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of months when HOUST > 12-month low over a 5-year window.
